mapper.select: select r.*, ( select count(*) from message msg where msg.message_room = r.room_no and msg.message_time > NVL(r.last_employee_read_time, to_date('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) AS unread_cnt from room r where r.room_no = #{roomNo}

SELECT r.*, M.last_time, M.last_content, ( SELECT count(*) FROM message msg INNER JOIN message_chat mc ON mc.message_no = msg.message_no WHERE msg.message_room = r.room_no AND mc.message_sender_no != #{accountNo} -- 내가 보낸 메세지 제외 AND msg.message_time > NVL(ru.last_read_time, to_date('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) AS unread_cnt FROM room r INNER JOIN room_user ru ON ru.room_no = r.room_no AND ru.account_no = #{accountNo} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT message_room, max(message_time) as last_time, max(message_content) keep (dense_rank last order by message_time) as last_content FROM message GROUP BY message_room ) M ON r.room_no = M.message_room WHERE r.room_type = '상담'

SELECT r.*, M.last_time, M.last_content, ( SELECT count(*) FROM message msg INNER JOIN message_chat mc ON mc.message_no = msg.message_no WHERE msg.message_room = r.room_no AND mc.message_sender_no != #{myAccountNo} -- 내가 보낸 메세지 제외 AND msg.message_time > NVL(ru_me.last_read_time, to_date('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) AS unread_cnt FROM room r -- 1. 나의 참여 정보 조인 (읽음 시간 확인용) INNER JOIN room_user ru_me ON ru_me.room_no = r.room_no AND ru_me.account_no = #{myAccountNo} -- 2. 강사의 참여 정보 조인 (tutor 테이블에서 account_no를 조회하여 매칭) INNER JOIN room_user ru_other ON ru_other.room_no = r.room_no AND ru_other.account_no = #{accountNo} -- 3. 마지막 메세지 정보 (방이 생성되고 메세지가 없을 수도 있으므로 LEFT JOIN 권장) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT message_room, MAX(message_time) AS last_time, MAX(message_content) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY message_time) AS last_content FROM message GROUP BY message_room ) M ON r.room_no = M.message_room WHERE r.room_type = '개인'

select R.*, A.account_no, A.account_type, A.account_name, M.last_time, M.last_content, NVL(U.cnt, 0) cnt, ( select count(*) from message msg inner join message_chat mc on mc.message_no = msg.message_no where msg.message_room = r.room_no and mc.message_sender_no = r.room_owner and (r.last_employee_read_time is null or msg.message_time > r.last_employee_read_time) ) as unread_cnt, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_user RU WHERE RU.room_no = R.room_no AND RU.account_no = #{accountNo} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as enter from room R left join ( select room_no, count(*) cnt from room_user group by room_no ) U on R.room_no = U.room_no inner join ( select message_room, max(message_time) as last_time, max(message_content) keep (dense_rank last order by message_time) as last_content from message group by message_room ) M on R.room_no = M.message_room inner join account A on A.account_no = R.room_owner where R.room_type = '상담' order by M.last_time desc

SELECT R.*, A.account_no, A.account_type, A.account_name, M.last_time, M.last_content, NVL(U.cnt, 0) AS cnt, ( SELECT count(*) FROM message msg INNER JOIN message_chat mc ON mc.message_no = msg.message_no WHERE msg.message_room = R.room_no AND mc.message_sender_no != #{accountNo} -- 내가 보낸 메세지 제외 AND msg.message_time > NVL(ru_me.last_read_time, to_date('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) AS unread_cnt, 'Y' AS enter FROM room R INNER JOIN room_user ru_me ON ru_me.room_no = R.room_no AND ru_me.account_no = #{accountNo} INNER JOIN room_user ru_other ON ru_other.room_no = R.room_no AND ru_other.account_no != #{accountNo} INNER JOIN account A ON A.account_no = ru_other.account_no INNER JOIN ( SELECT room_no, count(*) cnt FROM room_user GROUP BY room_no ) U ON R.room_no = U.room_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT message_room, max(message_time) as last_time, max(message_content) keep (dense_rank last order by message_time) as last_content FROM message GROUP BY message_room ) M ON R.room_no = M.message_room WHERE R.room_type = '개인' ORDER BY M.last_time DESC

WITH TargetUsers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.account_no, '학생' AS account_type FROM employee e JOIN course c ON e.employee_no = c.employee_no JOIN student_course sc ON c.course_no = sc.course_no JOIN student s ON sc.student_no = s.student_no WHERE e.account_no = #{accountNo} UNION SELECT DISTINCT p.account_no, '학부모' AS account_type FROM employee e JOIN course c ON e.employee_no = c.employee_no JOIN student_course sc ON c.course_no = sc.course_no JOIN parent_student ps ON sc.student_no = ps.student_no JOIN parent p ON ps.parent_no = p.parent_no WHERE e.account_no = #{accountNo} ), SharedRooms AS ( SELECT rm.*, ru_other.account_no AS target_account_no, ru_me.last_read_time FROM room rm JOIN room_user ru_me ON rm.room_no = ru_me.room_no JOIN room_user ru_other ON rm.room_no = ru_other.room_no WHERE ru_me.account_no = #{accountNo} AND ru_other.account_no != #{accountNo} AND rm.room_type = '개인' ) SELECT A.account_no, A.account_type, A.account_name, sr.*, M.last_time, M.last_content, NVL(U.cnt, 0) AS cnt, ( SELECT count(*) FROM message msg INNER JOIN message_chat mc ON mc.message_no = msg.message_no WHERE msg.message_room = SR.room_no AND mc.message_sender_no != #{accountNo} -- 내가 보낸 메세지 제외 AND msg.message_time > NVL(sr.last_read_time, to_date('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) AS unread_cnt, 'Y' AS enter FROM TargetUsers tu JOIN account a ON tu.account_no = a.account_no LEFT JOIN SharedRooms sr ON tu.account_no = sr.target_account_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_no, count(*) cnt FROM room_user GROUP BY room_no ) U ON SR.room_no = U.room_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT message_room, max(message_time) as last_time, max(message_content) keep (dense_rank last order by message_time) as last_content FROM message GROUP BY message_room ) M ON SR.room_no = M.message_room ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.room_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, tu.account_type ASC, a.account_no

WITH TargetUsers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT e.account_no, '직원' AS account_type FROM student s JOIN student_course sc ON s.student_no = sc.student_no JOIN course c ON sc.course_no = c.course_no JOIN employee e ON c.employee_no = e.employee_no WHERE s.account_no = #{accountNo} UNION SELECT DISTINCT e.account_no, '직원' AS account_type FROM parent p JOIN parent_student ps ON p.parent_no = ps.parent_no JOIN student_course sc ON ps.student_no = sc.student_no JOIN course c ON sc.course_no = c.course_no JOIN employee e ON c.employee_no = e.employee_no WHERE p.account_no = #{accountNo} ), SharedRooms AS ( SELECT rm.*, ru_other.account_no AS target_account_no, ru_me.last_read_time FROM room rm JOIN room_user ru_me ON rm.room_no = ru_me.room_no JOIN room_user ru_other ON rm.room_no = ru_other.room_no WHERE ru_me.account_no = #{accountNo} AND ru_other.account_no != #{accountNo} AND rm.room_type = '개인' ) SELECT a.account_no, tu.account_type, a.account_name, sr.*, M.last_time, M.last_content, NVL(U.cnt, 0) AS cnt, ( SELECT count(*) FROM message msg INNER JOIN message_chat mc ON mc.message_no = msg.message_no WHERE msg.message_room = sr.room_no AND mc.message_sender_no != #{accountNo} -- 내가 보낸 메세지 제외 AND msg.message_time > NVL(sr.last_read_time, to_date('1970-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) AS unread_cnt, 'Y' AS enter FROM TargetUsers tu JOIN account a ON tu.account_no = a.account_no LEFT JOIN SharedRooms sr ON tu.account_no = sr.target_account_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_no, count(*) cnt FROM room_user GROUP BY room_no ) U ON sr.room_no = U.room_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT message_room, max(message_time) as last_time, max(message_content) keep (dense_rank last order by message_time) as last_content FROM message GROUP BY message_room ) M ON sr.room_no = M.message_room ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.room_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, tu.account_type ASC, a.account_no

select R.*, nvl(U.cnt, 0) cnt, nvl2(MY.account_id, 'Y', 'N') enter from room R left outer join ( select room_no, count(*) cnt from room_user group by room_no ) U on R.room_no = U.room_no left outer join ( select * from room_user where account_no = #{accountNo} ) MY on R.room_no = MY.room_no order by R.room_no asc
select ACC.account_no, ACC.account_name, ACC.account_type from room_user RU inner join account ACC on RU.account_no = ACC.account_no where room_no = #{roomNo}
mapper.insert: insert into room_user(room_user_no, room_no, account_no) values(#{roomUserNo}, #{roomNo}, #{accountNo})
